summary: New Progress tab: a week overview (calorie bars, weight card, macro averages) plus Calories / Macros / Nutrients / Weight views with week navigation, stacked macro split bars against the target, foods highest in carbs, fat and protein, and a CSV export of the shown week.
why: Brings the MyFitnessPal progress screens the owner uses into genki, read-only over the existing food log and weigh-ins.
